Sentence (English): We had to replace a Technica (Bellissimo) that for the 2 time had rusting baskets and more recently a busted dispenser due to dropping a plate on it.
Comments (English): [ Best choice for the $$$ ] || ---------------- || We had to replace a Technica (Bellissimo) that for the 2 time had rusting baskets and more recently a busted dispenser due to dropping a plate on it. So we weren't looking to spend a whole lot of money considering even some of the best brands/models had reviews that expressed all kinds of issues and poor backup service.The Haier however, had pretty good reviews (or at least reviews where we were willing to accept the negatives) and the price was what we were willing to pay for such an appliance. The online ordering, payment and delivery were great from Appliances Online. The dishwasher itself was as easy to install as any. I was actually surprised to see a few simple little "quality of life" features I didn't expect from a cheaper priced product like plastic clips on the rear to hold cables/hoses should you need. But other more up-market features like the self-opening door after the cycle has finished which I have generally only seen on more expensive machines is a little bit of luxury I was impressed with too. This machine in its freestanding form with the top left on was about 50mm taller than our old machine which made for a better fit in the space our builders provided. This made for a more aesthetically pleasing appearance in our kitchen, no more unsightly large gaps. The operation of the machine itself is intuitive in my opinion, logical I would say. Simply put there are 2 rows of options. The top row contains the program selections, and the second row contains extended or truncated features to be applied to the program you choose. You adjust each row by pressing the relative >> buttons which progress the selection from left to right with a little LED underneath as it moves along. So, press the power button, select your desired program/extras and press start/play. The machine starts and shows a countdown timer (which seemed to be a huge gripe of many people when reviewing other machines that don't have this feature) and away you go. During its operation the machine is very quiet, we can easily have it running while going about our normal routine. In fact, our plan from now on is to put it on before bedtime so that the plastics have a better chance of drying. Depending on the program there does however seem to be times early on where the volume increases during what sounds like high pressure water blasting. I haven't read about every feature of the machine, but I assume it's a part of the particular program selection that's designed to loosen stubborn food particles. It doesn't last long, and it doesn't happen throughout the entire cycle. Unfortunately, this won't be a definitive review for many people because we like to rinse and remove loose food from our dishes before we "sanitise" them in the dishwasher. We do this to avoid having that old dishwasher-cooked food smell in the kitchen/living area and we never really have to clean the machine itself by doing it this way. So as far as heavy-duty cycles on dishes and pots that are just scraped and placed in the machine, we can't comment. We typically use the 70 min cycle which is the 60-minute cycle plus the extra drying feature and if we do the overnight wash the only water left on the dishes is what gets trapped in lips/crevasse areas that can't be faced down to drain properly. Even then it's not much. In regard to longevity, I have no idea since we've only had the machine for about a month as of this review. I will update it should we come across any major issues. At this stage we couldn't be happier with the product and to be honest that shouldn't surprise us because we also have a Haier refrigerator that we bought as a stand in while we were building our new house. That was over 4 years ago now and we kept it because it's one of the best fridges we've had. Haier for the win it seems!

Sentence (English): My dishwasher, which I've had for over 10 years, broke down.
Comments (English): [ It's a cost-effective ODM product from a major company, so I can't not buy it! ] || ---------------- || My dishwasher, which I've had for over 10 years, broke down. My husband slammed it from above! My kid kicked it! The door wouldn't close anymore, and I was washing dishes until my hands were chapped. I was so angry! I was already using this product because it brought me so much happiness, but in my anger, I bought it right away. I hadn't thought much about it, so I initially planned to order from a well-known brand. But a friend who uses the internet a lot told me that dishwashers are often ODMs, except for certain brands, and that I should just buy a good, cost-effective product. So I looked into it and found that a brand I always trust was selling this product as an ODM, so I ordered it right away. It was about half the price. At first, I was worried about the high installation costs. But the next day, I went to Coupang Rocket Installation and ordered without hesitation. I was more careful and thorough than anyone else. Some people say they buy hundreds-dollar items based solely on reputation, but I bought it on impulse, so I wanted to make sure I didn't regret my decision. I wanted to find a good product at a low price. The more I looked into it, the more I realized it was incredibly cost-effective! Everyone said hot air drying wasn't necessary because of the electricity bill, so I looked for a product that simply opened the lid. It was exactly what I wanted: thorough cleaning, an automatic door opening, and, best of all, about half the price of other products. I didn't even hesitate an hour before ordering. Since my previous dishwasher was for 12 people, I ordered the 12-person size. I simply removed the old one and installed it, so installation didn't take too long. They even took the old one with them, so I didn't have to worry about disposing of it, and it was easy to dispose of. I was wondering why I chose the black design. I wanted to order gray, but now that it's installed, black doesn't look bad either! Since my refrigerator is black, I made a good choice. I was excited to turn on the dishwasher, and it cleaned all the stuck-on rice, chili powder, and grease, which was a delight! It wasn't too noisy, and the included cutlery holder was spacious. It's a great deal! Plus, Coupang offers a two-year warranty, so I trust it more than any other company! Sentence (English): I was blown away when I realized my brand new LG dishwasher DID NOT DRY THE DISHES !
Comments (English): [ AVOID THIS MACHINE AT ALL COSTS / BELIEVE ME. ] || ---------------- || I was blown away when I realized my brand new LG dishwasher DID NOT DRY THE DISHES ! It does indeed wash the dishes but does not DRY the dishes . you need to do that yourself. Kind of like living with a roommate. In this day and age I never thought this was a possibility. The LG technician informed me that the unit has a very small heater and that I NEEDED TO RUN MY TAP WATER TO GET THE WATER UP TO TEMPERATURE BEFORE USING THE MACHINE. To my mind, this counteracts ANY water savings this new unit might offer. It appears that the unit relies on customer added additional chemicals to "drip dry" the dishes. This not only adds to the cost of use and requires over night wash times, but puts additional chemicals out into the environment. This is just crazy. I spent close to $800 and I now have a brand new machine that does not perform as well as the ten year old unit it replaces. There is NO WAY I could ever tell a friend in good faith to buy this machine . unless they really liked standing in the kitchen and towel drying their dishes. I'm not trying to be a jerk about this but $800 is a lot of money these days, not to mention the hassle of installation . My new car parks itself so it NEVER crossed my mind that in 2023 a new dishwasher would not dry the dishes.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher to replace my less-than-10-year-old Samsung model.
Comments (English): [ Living up to its name ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher to replace my less-than-10-year-old Samsung model. I installed it myself and it was very easy and straightforward. I like the location of the water connection. It wasn't cumbersome to attach the hose. As for performance, this one is the Rolls Royce compared to its Samsung predecessor. First of all, it's very quiet. All the reviews are true - you can barely hear this thing operating. I also decided on the 500 series because it comes equipped with the "Auto Air" setting, which I also particularly love because it resolves the issue with condensation on the back of the door! At the end of the cycle, the door pops open a little to allow the dishes to air dry. So when I come out in the kitchen in the morning, I know the dishes are done when I see the door open. I also like the little red light that shines on the floor to indicate it's on. But another thing I really like is that I connected it to the Home Connect app and I get a notification sent to my phone when the cycle is complete. I also can open the app and check for myself how long is left on the cycle. The inside is spacious and I'm able to fit a lot of dishes and get a nice, clean wash every time. I also very much like the 3rd shelf because it compensates for the smaller silverware holder. One other thing that is a bit obscure that I like. I like that the door is magnetized! I have a "Clean/Dirty" magnet that I had bought with the old dishwasher. Well my old dishwasher was not magnetized so I could never use the magnet for its intended use. But now I finally can. It's the little things I consider a win. In short, this dishwasher is a HUGE improvement from my previous one and I can tell it's going to last me for years and years (unlike my last one! ) I would definitely recommend spending the little bit of extra money to get yourself a Bosch. There's a reason they get stellar reviews.

Sentence (English): I recently purchased the Bosch 500 series dishwasher to replace a broken GE dishwasher we've had for 6 years.
Comments (English): [ What a difference a dishwasher makes! ] || ---------------- || I recently purchased the Bosch 500 series dishwasher to replace a broken GE dishwasher we've had for 6 years. I must say, it has completely transformed my daily routine. This dishwasher is a game-changer. The standout feature of this dishwasher is its remarkable quietness. Gone are the days of interrupting conversations or having to crank up the volume on the TV just to drown out the racket of a running dishwasher. This dishwasher operates at a near-silent level, allowing me to enjoy the peace and tranquility of my home while it efficiently tackles the day's dirty dishes. I love that there's a slight red light that illuminates the floor to let me know that it's on. But silence is not the only attribute that sets this dishwasher apart. Its drying capabilities are truly exceptional. I've tried many dishwashers in the past, and none have left my dishes as spotless and bone-dry as this. Whether it's delicate glassware or heavy-duty pots and pans, everything comes out immaculately dried and ready to be put away – no more tedious towel-drying or water spots to contend with. When it comes to the price, the Bosch 500 Series is worth every dollar invested. The quality and performance justify the initial cost, and the long-term savings on water and energy bills make it a smart financial choice. It's an investment in the comfort and convenience of your daily life, and one that pays off in more ways than one. No wonder this dishwasher was suggested by many online forums and kitchen appliance stores I've visited! The only thing I may think about a bit longer is whether paying extra for the handle bar would've been worth it. I used to hang my towels on there but now that this washer doesn't have a bar, it does look better but it's taken me a little longer to get used to. But it's certainly a minor issue. In conclusion, this dishwasher is a standout performer in the world of dishwashers. Its whisper-quiet operation and exceptional drying capabilities make it a top-tier choice for any household. You definitely get what you pay for. It's a purchase you won't regret.

Comments (English): [ Poor quality and even worse customer service ] || ---------------- || Our less than two year old LG dishwasher had the motor burn out. Long story short the parts are under warranty but labor is our expense. We called Best Buy to set up a service call, they won't order the part without payment ($350.00 part which is under warranty) because they have a hard time getting LG to reimburse them. We would have to pay for the part, the service call, and installation and try to get reimbursed from LG ourselves. If the vendor can't get reimbursed I don't have much faith that I would either. We then found a technician from a local company that would work on it, he would need to come out and diagnose it($89)and we would order the part ourselves from LG with a copy of the service call receipt. Not ideal but no other option to not be out $350 and waiting for LG to maybe reimburse us. The technician then discovered the wiring harness was charred as well and said he can't work on it if it could or has caught fire. The wiring harness is $187.00. We now have no one that will work on the dishwasher and LG refuses to send the parts to our home, they will only send them to a technician which we would have to start all over with service calls due to the wiring harness being charred. So we have paid for a service call and still no parts or a way to fix it. LG ended the chat today when they were asked if we could talk to a manager or someone that could help us. We have been polite and patient through this whole process, we just want a working dishwasher. The technician that did come out said LG dishwashers are notorious for this problem and are known for their horrendous customer service. The positive reviews are likely from those who haven't had the dishwasher more than a year. Best Buy was no help at all in making this right. I will never purchase another LG appliance or purchase from Best Buy. I feel Best Buy should stand behind the products they sell and at the very least work with LG on warranty calls so the customer isn't out almost $500 in parts alone on a warranty repair. We are giving up and purchasing a Bosch from a retailer that stands behind the products they sell. Unfortunately, Best Buy will not. LG for sure does not. This has been a disappointing and costly lesson.
